text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021. The total loss area was 81.3 hectares, which corresponds to about 2.23% of the asset's total area. This loss was primarily in planted forests, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. An additional 37.3 hectares of tree cover was lost in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, but these were not counted as part of the event due to the minimum event area threshold set at 0.5 hectares.
